think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and normal numeric domain. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that change semantics (disable/auto/unlimited) rather than just scaling the same behavior. 3) Determine whether such values break the natural order by switching the knob into a qualitatively different mode. 4) If a sentinel exists, mark as special and list the sentinel value(s); otherwise mark as not special.
